features.note: Faithful migration: WinUI 3 app builds, runs, and renders a clean non-blank frame. All interactive controls present in the UIA tree (PhotoButton, VideoButton, FaceDetectionButton) plus the migrated camera-preview Image (CaptureElement->Image, automationId=PreviewImage) and a defensive 'No camera device found' fallback. Structural gate: coverage 3/5 -> partial (PreviewControl matched under its new name PreviewImage; FacesCanvas is a Canvas with no UIA peer in either framework — both false-negatives, not real gaps). Not scored 'pass' because the three buttons are IsEnabled=False (camera-hardware-gated on this VM) and could not be actuated to positively confirm behavior. No behavioral regression: the UWP golden is gated identically and had no responding controls.
